ideas.title: Movie night in
ideas.description: Pick a film neither of you has seen, order pizza, dim the lights and enjoy.

ideas.title: Evening walk
ideas.description: Find a nice route, walk together and talk — no phones.

ideas.title: Cook something new
ideas.description: Pick a recipe you've never tried, shop for ingredients and cook it together.

ideas.title: Morning coffee
ideas.description: Find a quiet little café, sit down with coffee and a book and just be.

ideas.title: Photo walk
ideas.description: Take your phones, wander the streets and capture beautiful moments together.

ideas.title: Picnic in the park
ideas.description: Pack some snacks, lay out a blanket and spend an afternoon under the sky.

ideas.title: Watch the sunset
ideas.description: Find a rooftop or a view and watch the sun go down together.

ideas.title: Game night
ideas.description: Play a board game or card game — loser has to do something for the other.
